description: Land Acquisition - F. Topo PP 17 and F. Topo PP 535 in Thalagoda, Naula D/S Division, Matale District - Amendments to the Notice No. 07-599 and No. 07-598 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1557/12 of 09.07.2008 by Ambagamuwa Korale D/S Division
